snapshot: Retained retrospective snapshot; not historical real-time availability
geography: Current Seoul25 and collected Gyeonggi36 regions; no Incheon
area_groups: Native exact UnitType17/18 and25/26 combined after alignment; not exact59/84sqm
rate_definition: Explicit direct flag / all merged reported contracts; includes cancelled direct records
match_support: At least three confirmed noncancelled broker controls; unknown floors excluded
quarter_clock: Same-quarter retrospective controls; first quarter is only2021.11-12 inside the fixed window
composition_definition: Common region/native-area-group/quarter cells with ten contracts per category; direct-count weights for both means
limitations: Selected supported contracts, not all direct trades or a causal direct-sale discount
Floor bands and exact type do not identify the same dwelling, condition, view or parties
Model prior-event alignment and same-quarter matching are distinct retrospective comparisons
No exact complex counts, cell weights, small broker-control summaries, individual prices or B arithmetic means
Linear count/model-gap certificates do not guarantee anonymity against nonlinear or arbitrary external information
coverage_policy: Shown n always describes the displayed distribution. When coverage_status is not supported, both the exact population denominator and percentage are withheld.
